rationale: The varied-schedule experiment 76e6ad3a9fa342638e9c16a1a27fdda6-experiment has been executed and retained, so this update records that the removed-leader stall is reproduced under a schedule that rotates the tick order and reverses the delivery order, which was the strongest remaining objection to the earlier basis: the same predicates are violated and held respectively, so the nonprogress is not an artefact of the fixed order. The observed instance is recorded as durable knowledge and the boundary conditions of this variation stay in the limitations.

knowledge.statement: In the retained execution of the varied-schedule experiment (freshly elected three-voter clusters {1,2,3}, node 1 leader, its own removal proposed, replicated, committed and applied on every node with the applied index advanced, fault-free delivery with the tick order rotated each round and the delivery order reversed on alternating rounds), the StepDownOnRemoval false probe kept node 1 as StateLeader outside the configuration and, across 120 varied rounds (parsed index 1), no eligible node took leadership (new_leader_elected false, new_leader_id 0, states_after_window {1: StateLeader, 2: StateFollower, 3: StateFollower}), the removal had committed (removal_committed true), last_index and committed_after stayed at 2, nothing was undelivered and the eligible voters' election timers were 1 and 0. With StepDownOnRemoval true the same varied window elected node 2 (index 3: new_leader_elected true, new_leader_id 2, states_after_window {1: StateFollower, 2: StateLeader, 3: StateFollower}).
knowledge.conditions: One executed in-process experiment with the fixed harness bytes of experiment 76e6ad3a9fa342638e9c16a1a27fdda6-experiment (receipt 118ff9bee5224b44a42aefba8d0ad788, exit 0, changed_target_files [], no parsing errors); every node was ticked once per round and every produced message was delivered, only the orders varied, and no restart, snapshot, partition, joint configuration or operator action was simulated. One observed instance under these conditions, not a universal guarantee.

interpretations.rationale: Receipt 118ff9bee5224b44a42aefba8d0ad788 is a completed execution of this investigation's successor experiment on the varied-schedule basis (status completed, exit 0, outcome tests_passed, unchanged target files, no parsing errors, 4 parsed events). Comparison 0, unchanged in meaning, declares that with StepDownOnRemoval false the cluster elects a new leader inside the window without external help; it is violated with a complete valid witness at parsed index 1, correlated to its own admission at index 0 (schedule_setup: probe varied/stepdown-false, rounds 120, leader_state StateLeader, voters [1,2,3], committed 1). The measured operands are new_leader_elected false with new_leader_id 0, states_after_window showing node 1 still leader and nodes 2 and 3 still followers, removal_committed true, last_index_after 2 with committed_after 2, leader_in_config false, undelivered_messages 0 and the eligible voters' election timers at 1 and 0. Comparison 1 is the control over the same varied schedule and holds at index 3, correlated to its admission at index 2: with Config.StepDownOnRemoval true the identical removal and the identical window elected node 2, so the schedule variation still distinguishes the two cases and the harness, the removal and the ticking are functional. The mechanism remains the sourced one: switchToConfig keeps the role for a leader absent from the new configuration when step-down is not requested (raft.go:1975-2030), stepLeader drops proposals without a progress entry (raft.go:1290-1295), and tickHeartbeat keeps broadcasting heartbeats that reset the eligible voters' timers (raft.go:862-889, 692-707). Engineering significance: with the fixed-order objection addressed, the observed nonprogress is attributable to the missing step-down rather than to the tick or delivery order, while the claim stays bounded to fault-free, complete delivery with varying orders, one cluster size and one execution per probe; the predecessor interpretations on the earlier bases remain recorded and were not revised.
counterevidence: Config.StepDownOnRemoval remains a documented knob and the control shows the same varied window elects a leader when it is enabled, so the stalled behaviour can still be read as the intended consequence of the default setting.
The variation covers order only: every node is ticked once per round and every message is delivered, so loss, duplication, long delay and partition scenarios remain outside the observation.
The window is 120 rounds in one process with one executed instance per probe; other cluster sizes, joint configurations and demotion of the leader were not exercised.

An operator or a forced election ends the stall, as the earlier boundary control showed on the fixed-order basis; this interpretation does not revise that finding and does not claim the cluster is unrecoverable.

The stall is observed while the ineligible leader keeps receiving quorum acknowledgments from the eligible voters; a fault that stops those acknowledgments could change the picture and was not probed.
limitations: One executed instance per probe with a bounded 120-round window under a specific variation of order; it is not a proof over all schedules or an unbounded guarantee.
Only simple removal of the leader in a three-voter cluster is covered; larger or smaller clusters, joint configurations, learner demotion and multi-node changes were not probed.
The schedule variation is deterministic (rotation and alternating reversal) rather than randomised over many seeds.
Whether an embedding service is expected to configure step-down or to intervene is a contract question outside the snapshot, so severity and defect classification remain with human review.
This interpretation covers the varied-schedule successor only; the earlier fixed-order interpretations remain as recorded.
interpretations.report_title: 变更调度下的复现：被移除且不下台的 leader 仍使集群停滞（对照仍能选出新 leader）
interpretations.report_answer: 在 varied-schedule successor 实验（每轮轮换 tick 顺序、隔轮反转投递顺序，其余仍为无故障完整投递）中：StepDownOnRemoval=false 时被移除的 node 1 仍为 StateLeader 且已不在配置内，120 轮内没有任何合格节点成为 leader（states 仍为 leader+两个 follower），last_index 与 committed 均为 2、无未投递消息、两个合格 voter 的选举计时器为 1 与 0；对照 StepDownOnRemoval=true 在同样调度与窗口内选出 node 2 为 leader。因此该停滞并非固定 tick/投递顺序的产物，机制仍对应 switchToConfig 保留角色（raft.go:1975-2030）、无进度条目时丢弃提案（raft.go:1290-1295）与心跳持续重置选举计时器（raft.go:862-889、692-707）；结论仍限定于无故障完整投递、单一集群规模与每次一次执行，是否构成缺陷需人工复核。
